Register using the required personal details, active mobile number and email address.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The RRB NTPC 12th Pass application process starts on 15 October 2026. Candidates must submit the online form by 13 November, while the examination fee can be paid until 15 November 2026. A separate correction window is available after the application closing date. content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Vacancy 2026 Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Railway Recruitment Boards have announced 1,688 undergraduate vacancies across four posts. Commercial cum Ticket Clerk has the highest number of vacancies at 700, followed by Junior Clerk cum Typist with 600 posts. The detailed RRB-wise, Railway Zone-wise and post-wise vacancy distribution is provided in Annexure B of the official notification on pages 33–40. Candidates should check vacancies for their preferred RRB before submitting the application.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026 must have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognized board. The notification normally requires at least 50% aggregate marks, but specified candidates are exempt from this minimum-percentage condition. Qualification Cut-off: The required educational qualification must be completed by 13 November 2026. Candidates awaiting final examination results are not eligible to apply. Normally, candidates must secure at least 50% aggregate marks in Class 12. However, the minimum 50% condition is not applicable to the following candidates: Scheduled Caste candidates. Scheduled Tribe candidates. Persons with Benchmark Disabilities. Ex-Servicemen. Candidates possessing qualifications higher than Class 12. Yes. Candidates with qualifications higher than Class 12 can apply for the undergraduate posts if they satisfy the prescribed age, medical and other eligibility conditions. The 50% Class 12 minimum marks condition is not insisted upon for such candidates.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for all four RRB NTPC Undergraduate posts is 18 to 30 years as on 1 January 2027. Age relaxation is available to eligible reserved and other notified categories. Both dates are inclusive. The date of birth entered in the application must match the Class 10 or equivalent certificate. Age relaxation is subject to the conditions and documentary requirements provided in the notification.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Salary 2026
content_sections.text: RRB NTPC Undergraduate posts are placed under Pay Levels 2 and 3 of the 7th Central Pay Commission. The Commercial cum Ticket Clerk post carries initial basic pay of Rs. 21,700, while the remaining three posts carry Rs. 19,900. These are initial basic pay figures, not the total monthly take-home salary.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The RRB NTPC Undergraduate application fee is Rs. 500 for general applicants and Rs. 250 for the eligible concessional categories listed in the notification. Part or all of the examination fee is refundable, after deduction of applicable bank charges, only to candidates who appear in the first-stage CBT. Payment Methods: Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card and UPI. Only candidates appearing in CBT-1 are eligible for the prescribed refund. The refund is subject to deduction of applicable bank charges. Refunds are processed to an Aadhaar-seeded bank account as provided in the notification. Candidates must ensure their bank account is correctly linked with Aadhaar. Rejected or incomplete applications do not qualify for a fee refund. Important: Economically Backward Class (EBC), Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Other Backward Class (OBC) are different categories. EBC concession is based on the conditions specified in the notification and does not itself provide job reservation.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment process consists of two Computer Based Tests, followed by document verification and medical examination. Unlike several previous NTPC recruitment cycles, CEN 07/2026 does not require a separate Computer Based Typing Skill Test for Junior Clerk cum Typist or Accounts Clerk cum Typist. CBT-1: First-stage Computer Based Test for all four posts. CBT-2: Second-stage Computer Based Test for shortlisted candidates. Document Verification: Verification of original educational, identity, category and other required documents. Medical Examination: Candidates must pass the prescribed medical fitness standard for their allotted post. No. The Computer Based Typing Skill Test for Junior Clerk cum Typist and Accounts Clerk cum Typist has been dispensed with under CEN 07/2026. Candidates are still expected to possess basic computer and adequate typing proficiency, which may be assessed after joining.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate CBT-1 Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The RRB NTPC Undergraduate first-stage CBT contains 100 objective-type questions for 100 marks. The examination duration is 90 minutes, and one-third of a mark is deducted for every incorrect answer. Duration: 90 Minutes. Negative Marking: 1/3 mark per incorrect answer. Scribe-eligible Candidates: 120 Minutes.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate CBT-2 Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted through CBT-1 will appear for CBT-2. The second-stage CBT contains 120 questions carrying 120 marks, with a duration of 90 minutes. Duration: 90 Minutes. Negative Marking: 1/3 mark per incorrect answer. Scribe-eligible Candidates: 120 Minutes. These minimum qualifying percentages apply to the CBTs. PwBD candidates may receive the specified relaxation when the notification's conditions are met. Qualifying marks alone do not guarantee shortlisting.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The RRB NTPC Undergraduate syllabus for CBT-1 and CBT-2 covers Mathematics, General Intelligence and Reasoning, and General Awareness. Both stages have the same broad subjects but different question distributions. Number System, Decimals and Fractions LCM and HCF Ratio and Proportion Percentages Mensuration Time and Work Time and Distance Simple and Compound Interest Profit and Loss Elementary Algebra Geometry and Trigonometry Elementary Statistics Analogies Number and Alphabetical Series Coding and Decoding Mathematical Operations Similarities and Differences Relationships and Analytical Reasoning Syllogism Venn Diagrams Puzzles and Data Sufficiency Statement and Conclusion Decision Making Maps and Graph Interpretation Current Affairs - National and International Indian History and Freedom Struggle Indian and World Geography Indian Polity and Constitution Indian Economy General Science up to Class 10 Level Sports, Art, Culture and Literature Computer Basics and Applications Science and Technology Developments Government Schemes and Programmes Environmental Issues Indian Transport Systems Important National and International Organizations

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Medical Standards 2026
content_sections.text: Each undergraduate post has a prescribed railway medical standard. Candidates must satisfy the required fitness and vision conditions for the post they select. Candidates who have undergone LASIK or another procedure to correct refractive error are not eligible for posts requiring A-3 medical standards under this notification. For B-2 and C-2 posts, eligibility is subject to the medical conditions specified in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit only one online application through the unified official RRB website from 15 October to 13 November 2026. Candidates must carefully choose the RRB and their post preferences because important details cannot be changed later. Visit https://rrb.indianrailways.gov.in/ . Open the recruitment link for CEN No. 07/2026 - NTPC Undergraduate. Read the detailed notification, Annexure A and RRB-wise vacancy tables in Annexure B. Click Create an Account if you are a new applicant. Candidates who already created an RRB account for earlier CENs should use their existing login credentials. Register using the required personal details, active mobile number and email address. Complete Aadhaar or other permitted identity verification as directed by the application portal. Choose one Railway Recruitment Board. Enter the required personal, educational and reservation details. Select eligible posts, Railway Zones and Production Unit preferences carefully. Complete the live photograph capture as instructed by the portal. Upload the scanned signature and applicable supporting documents. Review the information and declaration carefully. Pay the prescribed examination fee using the available online payment method. Submit the application and retain the confirmation details. Important: The selected RRB and details entered during Create an Account cannot be modified later. Candidates must not submit multiple applications.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Photo and Signature Requirements 2026
content_sections.text: The RRB application process includes live photograph capture and upload of the candidate's signature. Candidates should follow the exact instructions to avoid application rejection. The candidate's photograph must be captured live through the application system. Do not upload or photograph an existing printed photograph. Follow the portal's instructions for face positioning, lighting and identity matching. The notification also requires eligible SC/ST candidates seeking a free train travel pass to upload the prescribed community certificate in PDF format.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Application Correction 2026
content_sections.text: The RRB NTPC Undergraduate application modification window will remain open from 16 November to 25 November 2026. Candidates can change permitted application details by paying a non-refundable modification fee of Rs. 250 for each modification.
